metadata.title: Team Terra — authoritative architect-register source inventory
metadata.scope: Five jurisdictional register sources for a mapping pilot; not a global register or an ingested architect dataset.
metadata.verification_scope: Official lookup interfaces, documentation, status semantics and download/reuse routes checked. No individual registrations verified and no register records bulk-downloaded.
metadata.entity_policy: Keep people, registrations, practices, offices and buildings separate. A registration jurisdiction is not an office location.
metadata.reuse_policy: Public lookup availability does not establish permission to bulk ingest or republish. Apply the documented access/reuse conditions and preserve source and checked date.

bulk_state_values.permission_required: Source terms require permission beyond personal/noncommercial use; no open bulk route verified.
bulk_state_values.documented_monthly_route_file_uninspecte: Official monthly disclosure route documented, but the particular board file has not been inspected or downloaded.
bulk_state_values.subscription_lookup_no_bulk_verified: Limited free lookup and subscription access documented; bulk export and republication rights unverified.
bulk_state_values.no_bulk_verified_live_lookup_preferred: No bulk/reuse route verified; regulator explicitly recommends the current live register over republished lists.

sources.name: Architects Registration Board — Architects Register
sources.status_semantics: Individual register. Search by registration number, name, company, address, country or postcode distance. Company search finds registered people, not a firm licence. Record an actual checked entry rather than treating a practice website as registration evidence.
sources.bulk_reuse_summary: ARB documents PDF availability. Register terms restrict copies to personal, noncommercial use and require written permission for broader reproduction/distribution. No open bulk API or reuse licence verified.
sources.recommended_next_step: Link to the official register; obtain a documented republication route before building a register-derived public dataset.

sources.name: California Architects Board / Department of Consumer Affairs
sources.status_semantics: CAB licenses individuals, not firms or corporations. Search by name, city, county or licence number. DCA reports current/expired and disciplinary states; preserve exact status, issue/expiry dates and check time.
sources.bulk_reuse_summary: DCA documents monthly public-information files per agency, refreshed at the beginning of each month; CAB is not listed among excluded agencies. Fields include licence identity, name, public address, city/region, issue/expiry and status. Linked Box folder could not be inspected; CAB file is uninspected and not downloaded. No separate reuse licence verified.
sources.recommended_next_step: Inspect the CAB file and applicable reuse terms through the official disclosure route. Start with professional identity, authority-scoped licence ID, literal status and city/region, with live checks for current status.

sources.name: NSW Architects Registration Board
sources.status_semantics: Separate individual register and corporation/firm list. Individuals can be practising or non-practising; non-practising permits the title but not provision of architectural services. Firms nominate a responsible architect. Preserve category and check disciplinary information separately.
sources.bulk_reuse_summary: No bulk/API route verified. Board copyright page permits personal reproduction and asks for Registrar permission for other reproduction, alteration, storage or transmission.
sources.recommended_next_step: Use source links and manual checks; obtain a documented data/republication route before ingesting. Model firms and nominated architects as separate linked entities.

sources.name: Council of Architecture
sources.status_semantics: National individual Register of Architects. Verification takes a CA registration number and security code. Directory searches include name, registration year/number, state, city and pincode. Preserve validity and reported discipline; a historical number alone does not prove current status.
sources.bulk_reuse_summary: Directory allows three free searches per day per IP; unlimited directory access requires subscription. No bulk export or republication licence verified. Subscription is not evidence of republication rights.
sources.recommended_next_step: Use limited manual verification within the published access model; request a documented data/republication route before any scale import.

sources.name: South African Council for the Architectural Profession
sources.status_semantics: Search by name/surname, registration type and province. Covers Professional Architect, Senior Architectural Technologist, Architectural Technologist, Architectural Draughtsperson, candidate and other specified categories. Preserve category and current standing; candidates are not independent professionals.
sources.bulk_reuse_summary: No bulk download or reuse permission verified. SACAP's May 2026 notice advises municipalities to refer people to its live register rather than republishing names/contact lists, citing changing status and personal-information concerns.
sources.recommended_next_step: Link to live verification. Obtain a documented republication route before register-derived listings, and never classify all SACAP categories as Professional Architect.
